as_told.title: Silent craft hovers 40 ft above car at Brook Park strip mall
as_told.place_text: Brook Park, Ohio, near NASA John Glenn Research Center

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he once saw a UFO, an unidentified flying object, come down and hover about 40 feet above his car, as if he was meant to see it. In a fuller version he places it at a strip mall in Brook Park, Ohio, near NASA's Glenn research centre, one February about fourteen years earlier, and says the craft was silent and that a friend named Tony was with him. He tells it as the reason he takes the subject seriously.
